title: Mecha hangar anime
prompt_en: Anime style, 16:9. A giant robot in a hangar powers on: eyes light up, steam vents hiss, cables drop away. Low angle camera, dramatic lighting, detailed mechanical lines, 90s anime aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 日系动画风格，16:9。机库里的巨型机器人启动：眼睛亮起，排气口喷出蒸汽，线缆脱落。低角度镜头，戏剧化光照，细致的机械线条，90 年代动画美学。
why_it_works: A clear trigger-to-effect sequence (power on → lights → steam) gives the model ordered events.
